info.name: MaternalGuard FHIR Validation
info.description:
Read-only Postman collection for validating MaternalGuard's write-back path against the Prompt Opinion FHIR store.

**What this collection is for.** After you click Approve / Reject / Activate / Dismiss in the morning-huddle dashboard, MaternalGuard writes back to the workspace FHIR store: Task.status changes, Flag.status changes, and every write emits a paired FHIR Provenance resource with the HL7 AI Transparency on FHIR AI-Provenance profile and an ONC HTI-1 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11)(iv)(A) Evidence-Based DSI source-attribute payload. This collection lets you fetch those resources by ID and inspect the wire shape without leaving Postman.

**Setup (60 seconds).**

1. Import this file into Postman: File > Import > drop this .json in.
2. Click the collection (root), then the Variables tab.
3. Paste your **bearerToken**. Fastest way to get it: open Prompt Opinion in your browser, open DevTools > Network, click any tool call, find the outbound request to your MaternalGuard server (POST /mcp), copy the value of the `X-FHIR-Access-Token` request header. That IS the bearer token for the workspace FHIR API. It rotates on session refresh — grab a fresh one whenever the collection returns 401.
4. **workspaceId** and **patientId** are pre-filled for Jonathan's local Maria Santos setup. Change them if you're on a different workspace or patient.
5. **taskId** and **flagId** are blank on purpose — fill them in when you want to inspect a specific resource. Server logs print the IDs on each ProposeMaternalAction / UpdateMaternalAction call in the form `[MCP] tool=... argKeys=[action,taskId]` — copy from there.

**What to look for on a successful validation.**

- `GET Patient/{{patientId}}` — 200 OK with `resourceType: Patient`. Confirms auth + patient exists.
- `GET Task?patient={{patientId}}&status=accepted` — bundle contains any task you just Approved. `Task.status === "accepted"` proves the FHIR write persisted.
- `GET Task/{{taskId}}` — inspect a specific task. `Task.reasonCode.coding` should include the NCQA HEDIS PPC identifier (system http://ncqa.org/hedis/identifiers, code PPC) plus a CPT Category II 0500F/0503F entry. `Task.basedOn[0].reference` should point at the NCQA canonical Measure URL.
- `GET Provenance?target=Task/{{taskId}}` — the trust-story b-roll. Look for:
  - `meta.profile[0]` = `http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/aitransparency/StructureDefinition/AI-Provenance`
  - `meta.security[0]` = `AIAST` (Artificial Intelligence Asserted)
  - `contained[0]` = the AI-Device with aiKind = rule-based
  - `contained[1]` = the AI-ModelCard DocumentReference with a CHAI Applied Model Card content slice
  - `extension[0].url` = `https://maternalguard.local/extensions/dsi-transparency/summary` with 13 (b)(11)(iv)(A) source-attribute sub-extensions filled in
  That is the ONC HTI-1 payload MaternalGuard emits on every write.

**Auth is Bearer** at the collection level — every request inherits it. The local health-check request opts out because localhost:5000 doesn't need auth.

variable.description: Prompt Opinion workspace UUID. Change to your workspace if not Jonathan's local.
Maria Santos on Jonathan's local workspace. Replace with any patient's FHIR id.
A Task UUID to inspect. Fill in from server-log lines like `[MCP] tool=UpdateMaternalAction argKeys=[action,taskId]` after a button click.
A Flag UUID to inspect. Same source as taskId.
Copy from Prompt Opinion browser DevTools > Network > your MCP request > X-FHIR-Access-Token header. Rotates on session refresh.
MaternalGuard MCP server on your machine.

request.description: Sanity check the local MaternalGuard MCP server is up and reports the expected version + tool list. No auth needed.
Verifies bearer token is valid and the patient resolves. Expect resourceType=Patient. If 401, refresh the bearerToken variable.
Bundle of every Task on the patient's chart. Filter for MaternalGuard drafts by checking Task.code.coding[0].system === 'http://maternalguard.local/task-codes'.
Everything currently in the dashboard's Draft tasks section. Bundle.total should match the (N) on the huddle card.
Every task the clinician has Approved. Should include whatever you just clicked Approve on. Proves the FHIR write persisted end-to-end.
Every task the clinician has Rejected. Each should have Task.statusReason.text = 'Rejected by clinician during huddle review' when the reject fired without a caller-supplied reason (server default).

Inspect a specific Task. Look for:
- Task.status
- Task.priority (urgent for RED, asap for YELLOW, routine for GREEN)
- Task.description (recommendation + rationale + guideline reference)
- Task.reasonCode.coding (NCQA HEDIS PPC identifier + CPT-II 0500F/0503F)
- Task.basedOn[0].reference (NCQA Measure canonical)
Bundle of every Flag on the patient's chart. MaternalGuard-authored flags have Flag.category[0].coding[0].system === 'http://maternalguard.local/flag-categories'.
Everything in the dashboard's Draft flags section.
Every Flag the clinician has clicked Activate on. Each should have Flag.extension containing the maternalguard.local/extensions/review-status extension flipped to 'clinician-activated'.

**The trust-story b-roll.** Any single Provenance in the bundle should carry:

- meta.profile[0] = http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/aitransparency/StructureDefinition/AI-Provenance
- meta.security[0].code = AIAST (Artificial Intelligence Asserted)
- agent[0].who.reference = #maternalguard-dsi-device (contained)
- contained[0] = the AI-Device with aiKind = rule-based and modelCardDescription
- contained[1] = an AI-ModelCard DocumentReference with a CHAI Applied Model Card content slice (application/json + text/markdown attachments)
- extension[0].url = https://maternalguard.local/extensions/dsi-transparency/summary with 13 (b)(11)(iv)(A) Evidence-Based source-attribute sub-extensions filled in (interventionName, purpose, intendedPopulation, cautionedOutOfScopeUse, algorithmMethodology, underlyingKnowledgeSource, developer, fundingSource, releaseDate, version, biasAssessment, warningsLimitations, regulatoryFramework)
Same AI-Transparency + (b)(11) shape as the Task Provenance, but targeting a Flag. Every Flag creation emits one; every UpdateMaternalAction on a Flag (activate/dismiss) emits another.

item.name: GET all Provenance for patient (via _include on Task)

request.description: Returns every Task for the patient PLUS every Provenance that targets one of those Tasks in a single bundle. Useful for one-shot audit trail verification.
